hypothesis: An ordinary DEE training collision writes an integer-translation response repertoire into a mobile memory carrier; a causal zero-s_reg relay can relocate that repertoire to a remote receiver, where it maps unseen queries n to n+delta. The trained source, memory lineage, on-path corridor, relay direction and receiver coupling are causally necessary, while source state and an off-path cut are irrelevant.

domain.sector: semantic-1 normal carriers in otherwise blank periodic cubic worlds

preparation: For each cell, cue B-x and teacher x+delta arrive synchronously at a training junction through normal carrier ports. Their ordinary reducer collision writes B+delta. After seven ticks the memory meets an ordinary semantic-1 relay with s_reg=0 and is redirected. Eleven ticks later an unseen query n meets the transferred carrier at a remote receiver. No hidden memory cell is edited and the decoder is fixed to receiver_s_reg-B.

observable.primary: exact receiver response direction and decoded value n+delta
observable.mechanism: training output, relay output, source consumption, cut target occupancy, empty injection port
observable.identity: response repertoire on queries excluded from the training input

model/rule.direction_rule: componentwise sign of the incoming directions

nulls: The receiver response is supplied by the query encoder.
Any occupied source or arbitrary label yields the expected function.
The apparent transfer is a coordinate coincidence independent of the causal corridor.
The source state rather than the learned response value controls the output.
PASS: All preregistered thresholds pass. Promote FUNCTIONAL_LEARNING_TRANSFER_CONFIRMED within the sealed sector and tested domain; interpret as continuous carrier-mediated functional transfer, not instantaneous or physical teleportation.
FAIL: Any preregistered threshold fails. Retain the discovery signal without promotion and report which causal/generalization condition failed.
INCONCLUSIVE: Technical/kernel identity failure, occupied injection ports, missing planned cases, or corrupted result prevents adjudication.
seed/data split: All sizes, frames, deltas, queries and seeds above are new and were frozen before execution; no external data are used.
falsifier: A planned positive case loses the exact unseen-query repertoire, a causally necessary control retains it, nuisance state/off-path cut destroys it, or event accounting contradicts the frozen reducer chain.
